note: Lifted semantic model, Beacon (radio-access) side. Home-grown, no standard vocabulary. Beacon and the packet-core controller are adjacent domains that touch only at the user-plane transport seam between the cell site and the core. Each concept carries a bespoke label, synonyms, a kind, a gloss, an example, the ad-hoc reference entry it bound to (ref; a native-only concept binds to a native-gap ref with no counterpart), relations, and instances. A live side volunteers gloss/example; an inert side exposes only label, kind, relations, and instances. ref=null marks an opaque item with no public meaning.

concepts.label: backhaul-link
concepts.gloss: the user-plane transport link carrying subscriber traffic from the cell site up to the core; the underlay the core's sessions ride
concepts.example: the 10G backhaul from site NR-because-441 to the core edge

concepts.label: site-gateway
concepts.gloss: the router at the cell site where the backhaul presents to the transport network; the demarcation toward the core
concepts.example: the CSG port at site NR-441 facing the transport ring

concepts.label: backhaul-marking
concepts.gloss: the DiffServ marking the backhaul honours on subscriber traffic across the transport
concepts.example: EF marking honoured for voice bearers on bh-441

concepts.label: backhaul-capacity
concepts.gloss: the committed transport capacity of the backhaul link available to subscriber traffic

concepts.label: backhaul-mtu
concepts.gloss: the transport MTU on the backhaul, sized to carry encapsulated user-plane packets without fragmentation
concepts.example: 1600-byte MTU on bh-441 to fit GTP overhead

concepts.label: radio-cell
concepts.gloss: a radio cell: the coverage area served from the site over the air interface — a radio-internal object with no transport counterpart

concepts.label: rrc-session
concepts.gloss: an RRC session: a device's radio-resource-control connection state on the air interface — a radio-internal notion of a 'session', unrelated to any transport or core session
concepts.example: the RRC-connected session for a handset in cell 441-A
